name: mauri-harness
description: What a repository enables beside Railly Skills: the route step between contract and implementation, the deploy gate after delivery, and the hooks that bind Railly's loop to the repository (its binding file, the verify-before-done Stop hook, the canonical root, secret scanning, formatting).

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: route, deploy-gate and the core hooks. Every harnessed repository enables this one.

plugins.name: harness-design
plugins.description: ui-design-language, for repositories without a design system of their own. A repository with one does not enable it.

plugins.name: harness-maintainer
plugins.description: maintain: queue cleanup, merge, release and published-artifact verification, for repositories that publish packages.
